nom: Dr. G Brightening Peeling Gel - Korean Skincare for Glowy Skin - Aqua Gommage Facial Exfoliator - Hyaluronic Acid

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including a few with rosacea or acne alongside sensitivity, report no burning, redness or irritation, describing it as gentle enough for regular use; one reviewer who does not consider her own skin sensitive still avoids harsh peels generally and found this one caused no stinging or barrier damage.
segments.normal: One reviewer who does not consider her skin sensitive says she normally avoids peeling gels because they can strip natural moisture and damage the skin barrier, but this one caused no irritation and left her skin soft and smooth.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it leaves skin feeling moisturized and soft rather than tight or stripped, with several specifically noting it does not pull moisture from the skin the way some peeling gels can; one reviewer still recommends following up with a moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers specifically note no burning or redness after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who usually avoids peeling gels because they can damage the skin barrier reports this one did not strip or damage her skin.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin says it is gentle and does not irritate her skin; another cautions that using it improperly, such as scrubbing too vigorously or applying too close to the eyes, may cause breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Peeling balls may be gel residue, not dead skin
Gentle massage-in, no hard scrubbing needed
Stiff tube is hard to squeeze

extraits.titre: Scam product. The paste itself clumps, its not removing skin.
extraits.texte: This product is a scam. Initially when using it, I was fooled like the other buyers. When rubbing it in it creates a bunch of white clumps that look like dead skin being exfoliated. But it's just the paste itself doing that. Put a drop on a plate and just smear it around with your finger and it does the same thing. This product ie a scam and any good results are just a placebo because of the fake "peeling" effect it has. In the picture below I put it on a plastic cup and smeared it around with a plastic spoon and it did the same clumping it does on skin. Guess the plastic cup had a lot of dead skin to exfoliate, huh.
This face mask was not what I expected! Once I placed it on my face, it appeared in tissue form and was messy.

extraits.titre: Use It Right And It’s A Skincare Gem!
extraits.texte: This is a great product that I can only use once a week at the moment. It brightens my skin and leaves it feeling clean & renewed. My family also notices. But as gentle as this product feels upon application, it is effective. No need to scrub hard. I’d recommend avoiding above and under your eye area, within the orbital bone. That area may be too sensitive for this and quite honestly, that area doesn’t need to be scrubbed. This is not for dark circles, trust! It may break you out if used improperly. But will do wonders and justice. I used ChatGPT as I journey my skin care routine so that it can help me make adjustments if I notice side effects it’s worth it!

extraits.titre: Works great for rosacea and sensitive skin
extraits.texte: This peeling gel is amazing! I have very sensitive skin and rosacea and this exfoliates but does not irritate my skin. It leaves my skin feeling soft and velvety.

extraits.titre: Gentle yet effective brightening peeling gel for more radiant smooth skin
extraits.texte: This brightening peeling gel is gentle, yet effective. It does not irritate my skin at all (even though I do not consider myself to have sensitive skin) but I usually do avoid any type of "peeling gel/cream" or harsh exfoliants that can strip away my skin's natural moisture and damage my skin barrier. I am not sure if there are small particles in this cream, but I would squeeze the product into my palms, before applying them onto my face, then I start to blend the products into my face and work in circular motion, and within seconds, I can feel it working, I did not feel any skin sensation, but what I meant was, I can feel the gel actually "exfoliating" and the feel of dead skin come off. I work that very well all over my face, before rinsing off my face with cool water. My skin feels baby soft and smooth afterwards. This is why I am a fan of Korean skin care products, they work so well, and some work way better than some luxury european skin care brands that I have spend a fortune on, and this brightening and peeling gel is at a fraction of their price, yet work so much better than some of the more expensive ones. This peeling gel is gentle enough for me to use at least 3-4x a week! Let's see how much it will improve my skin texture after I finish the first bottle. I definitely plan to repurchase.

extraits.titre: A gentle peel I actually feel comfortable using
extraits.texte: As a mom, I’m very careful with skincare — my skin doesn’t always react well to strong products, and I simply don’t have time to deal with irritation. This peeling gel turned out to be a really pleasant surprise. It’s very gentle, no burning or redness, and the process feels more like a soft massage than a harsh exfoliation. After using it, my skin feels smooth and fresh, but not dry or tight. I can use it in the evening and still feel comfortable putting on my regular skincare right after. I also appreciate that it doesn’t have a strong smell and rinses off easily — small things, but they matter when you’re always in a rush. I use it about once or twice a week, and that’s more than enough. The bottle lasts a long time, and the result is exactly what I want: clean, soft skin without stress. For busy moms who want gentle care that actually works, this is a great option.
